fichas.title: Multiplex Cinemas
fichas.summary: Multiplex cinemas combine auditoriums of varying sizes, often with shopping centres and car parks. They share an entrance and foyer; auditoriums may be stacked. Clear wayfinding, appropriately located screens, generous foyer and concession facilities, and suitable auditorium and projection-room layouts are emphasized.
spaces: Stores for cleaning firm and decoration
uses: Events such as premieres and presentations
